name: synergos-ui
description: Synergos UI — Multi-framework Web Components workspace

scripts.build: npm run build:angular && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vanilla
scripts.build:angular: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:elements,tag:scope:experiences,tag:scope:cms-adapter --parallel=6 --outputStyle=static
scripts.build:angular:elements: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:elements,tag:scope:cms-adapter --parallel=6 --outputStyle=static
scripts.build:angular:experiences: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:experiences --parallel=3 --outputStyle=static
scripts.build:angular:dev: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:elements --configuration=development --parallel=6 --outputStyle=static
scripts.build:angular:changed: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx affected --target=build --parallel=6 --outputStyle=static
scripts.build:angular:stable: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=tag:scope:elements,tag:scope:experiences,tag:scope:cms-adapter --parallel=1 --outputStyle=static
scripts.release: npm run build:angular && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:react && npm run build:svelte && npm run build:vanilla && npm run contracts:validate && npm run publish:runtime && node tools/publish.mjs --clean
scripts.release:angular: npm run build:angular && npm run build:runtime && npm run contracts:validate && npm run publish:runtime && node tools/publish.mjs --framework angular --clean
scripts.release:react: npm run build:react   && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework react    --clean
scripts.release:svelte: npm run build:svelte  && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework svelte   --clean
scripts.release:vanilla: npm run build:vanilla && npm run contracts:validate && node tools/publish.mjs --framework vanilla  --clean
scripts.test: npm run test:angular && npm run test:react && npm run test:svelte && npm run test:vanilla
scripts.test:angular: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:angular && npm run lint:react && npm run lint:svelte && npm run lint:vanilla
scripts.lint:angular: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx run-many --target=lint
scripts.contracts:validate: npm run element:audit && npm run manifest:validate
scripts.graph:angular: cd platforms/angular && cross-env NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT_PATH= NX_DAEMON=false npx nx graph
scripts.setup: npm run setup:angular && npm run setup:react && npm run setup:svelte && npm run setup:vanilla
